build_CLIP_model_from_state_dict: build a CLIP model from a PyTorch state dict using the build_model function
encode_image_with_CLIP: encode an image tensor into embeddings using the CLIP model encode_image method
encode_text_with_CLIP: encode text tokens into embeddings using the CLIP model encode_text method
convert_model_weights_to_fp16: convert applicable model parameters to fp16 using the convert_weights function
run_CLIP_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the CLIP model to get image and text embeddings with logit scale
